subject.title: [Feature]: Add runtime testing for skill workshop proposals before apply

question: What pre-apply runtime-validation boundary should Skill Workshop use for pending proposals?
rationale: Load/schema checks are relatively bounded, but invoking a proposed skill before apply may execute generated instructions, tools, filesystem writes, network calls, or other side effects before final approval.

options.title: Smoke-test only first
options.body: Add shared load/discovery/schema validation and record invocation as skipped until a side-effect contract exists.

options.title: Design full invocation tests
options.body: Define proposal-provided test inputs, expected outputs, allowed side effects, sandboxing, and tool policy before implementation.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle contract
options.body: Track runtime validation under the broader lifecycle-contract work so one source owns proposal health semantics.

recommendation.title: Smoke-test only first
recommendation.body: Add shared load/discovery/schema validation and record invocation as skipped until a side-effect contract exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Skill Workshop feature history makes this the strongest routing candidate for the service contract and safety-boundary decision.
